name: com.gc-airporttransfers/booking
title: GC Airport Transfers
description: Private airport & cruise transfers: Gold Coast, Brisbane, Byron Bay (Queensland). Quotes + bookings.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Full business facts for GC Airport Transfers — private (not shared-shuttle) fixed-price airport and cruise transfers in Queensland (Gold Coast, Brisbane, Byron Bay / Northern NSW): fleet, pricing list, policies, service area and contact details. Use this before answering questions about the service.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact per-vehicle prices from the live fixed price list for private Queensland airport transfers (Gold Coast OOL, Brisbane BNE) and Brisbane Cruise Terminal runs (use "Brisbane Cruise Terminal" or "Pinkenba" as the place), including Byron Bay / Northern NSW. Supports optional return trips (trip=return + return_date/return_time); return totals use the operator native return discount. Deterministic — never estimates. If match is "none", give the customer the phone number instead of guessing.

from.description: Pick-up place, e.g. "Broadbeach", "Byron Bay" or "OOL" (alias: pickup)

to.description: Drop-off place, e.g. "Gold Coast Airport", "Brisbane Airport" or a suburb (alias: dropoff)

pickup.description: Alias for from (same meaning as request_booking.pickup)

dropoff.description: Alias for to (same meaning as request_booking.dropoff)

pax.description: Passengers 1-16 (filters vehicles; 12-16 returns the two-vehicle Carnival+Maxi combination priced as a total). Groups over 16 return match "none" with contact details - do not quote them a price.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional)

time.description: HH:MM 24h in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional; flags after-hours surcharge)

trip.description: one_way (default) or return. When return, also send return_date and return_time.

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD return pick-up date in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional; implies trip=return)

return_time.description: HH:MM 24h return pick-up time in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional; implies trip=return)

luggage.description: Large bags (optional; filters vehicles and prefills the booking form)

flight.description: Flight number (optional; prefills the booking form)

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Date/time bookability in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) only — not prices (use get_quote for fares). Checks the operator's live settings for private Gold Coast / Brisbane / Byron Bay transfers (after-hours window, days off and blocked dates, optionally per vehicle). Times outside standard hours are bookable as after-hours requests (surcharge may apply); same-day should phone. Not a driver calendar: the operator confirms every booking.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving)

time.description: HH:MM 24h in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving)

vehicle.description: sedan | carnival | maxi | eqb | v300 (optional; checks that vehicle's days off)

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Lodge a booking REQUEST for a private (not shared-shuttle) fixed-price Queensland route — Gold Coast / Brisbane airport or Brisbane Cruise Terminal, including Byron Bay / Northern NSW. It is created as pending; the operator confirms and the customer receives a payment link by email. No payment happens through this tool. Confirm all details with the customer first. Date/time use Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (at least 1 hour ahead; same-day: phone instead)

time.description: HH:MM 24h in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving)

pax.description: Passengers 1-16. Over 16 cannot be booked online - give the customer the phone number.

vehicle.description: sedan | carnival | maxi | eqb (Mercedes EQB luxury SUV, up to 3) | v300 (Mercedes V300 luxury van, up to 6) - auto-upgraded if too small for pax

flight.description: Flight number (optional, enables free flight tracking)

notes.description: Anything else, e.g. child seats with ages (optional)

sandbox.description: Not supported: true is refused (this endpoint has no test mode; a request creates a real booking). Omit it.
